_note: Application workloads. 'fault_tolerant' workloads are given in logical resources (algorithm qubits, Toffoli/CCZ count and depth); 'variational' workloads run on physical qubits without error correction. classical_ops is the cost of the best classical alternative where one is quoted (None = no feasible classical method). Resource counts are from the cited papers, rounded.

shor_rsa2048.label: Shor, RSA-2048
shor_rsa2048.source: Gidney, arXiv:2505.15917 (2025): ~1.4k logical qubits, ~6.5e9 Toffoli (secondary-source figure; verify). Classical: GNFS L[1/3] heuristic, order of magnitude.

femoco_thc.label: FeMoco ground-state energy (THC qubitization)
femoco_thc.source: Lee et al., PRX Quantum 2, 030305 (2021); counts as quoted in arXiv:2108.12371 (verify against the paper).

chemistry_small.label: Small active-space chemistry (100 logical qubits)
chemistry_small.source: Illustrative mid-size fault-tolerant task for architecture comparison.

vqe_50q.label: Variational solver, 50 qubits, GPU optimiser
vqe_50q.source: Illustrative hybrid loop: each iteration samples the circuit, then a GPU step updates the parameters.

vqe_20q.label: Variational solver, 20 qubits, GPU optimiser
vqe_20q.source: Illustrative; small enough that exact classical simulation is cheap, which makes the energy comparison instructive.
